Bill.BriefDescription: Providing revenues for transportation projects linked to substantive transportation reforms.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing revenues for transportation projectslinked to substantive transportation reforms; amending RCW 82.38.030,82.38.035, 82.38.045, and 82.38.047; reenacting and amending RCW82.36.025 and 46.68.090; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the public trustmust be regained before any additional taxation for transportation isimposed on the public. The legislature finds that the best way toregain the public trust is to tie substantive reform and accountabilitymeasures to specific revenue measures, so that the revenue provisionsonly become law after the reforms are completed.
